title: Garlic German Noodles
description:
A comforting, umami-rich dish featuring rice stick noodles and lamination-puff, perfect for a sick day.
This dish is a creative take on traditional German cuisine, adapted to be FODMAP-friendly.

ingredients.name: lamination-puff
ingredients.notes: preferably day-old, broken into small pieces

instructions: Cook rice stick noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
Melt 30g of unsalted butter in a 28cm kadhai over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant and lightly golden.
Add broken lamination-puff to the kadhai and stir to coat with butter and garlic mixture.
Pour in cooked rice stick noodles, stirring to combine with the butter and puff mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, allowing the noodles to absorb the flavors.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot.
